purpose: Build one eight-circuit formal HF/HMF action space from immutable Phase2/3/4 measurement evidence without selecting runtime outcomes.
phase4_compatibility_gate: Generated aes_core/spi/tv80 source invocations and action rows must exactly reproduce candidate_space_v1 semantics.
phase2_refine_candidate_rule: When the historical refine table has no candidate column, assign the stable one-based source row order within that file.
deduplication_rule: Group by circuit, HF/HMF, H and optional M; retain every source candidate UID and reject outcome conflicts.
